name: Hotel Del Coronado
positioning: A 28-acre beachfront resort in Coronado built around the original 1888 Victorian hotel, a restored National Historic Landmark
best_for: Travelers who want a historic Victorian hotel right on the beach
Families who want a kids club, pools and beach experiences in one resort

facts.text: Hotel del Coronado is a 28-acre beachfront destination.
Rooms and suites are spread across three neighborhoods: the Victorian, the Cabanas and the Views.
The Victorian is the original beachfront hotel, established in 1888.
In the Victorian, no two rooms are alike.
Victorian rooms have a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and interior design that celebrates the Victorian era.
The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific.
Club Access rooms include daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access and curated afternoon bites.
Spa & Salon at The Del blends traditional wellness practices with modern spa techniques, using natural ingredients from the land and sea.
Children can join the Ocean Explorers Kids Club, or private childcare can be arranged, while parents visit the spa.
Some Like It Hot was filmed at Hotel del Coronado in 1958.
Nobu Del Coronado has indoor and al fresco dining, with a covered patio, a pagoda bar and a dedicated sushi bar.
Veranda is an al fresco restaurant with ocean views.

highlights.text: The original 1888 Victorian hotel is a lovingly restored National Historic Landmark.
The Cabanas sits at the heart of the resort, with a central pool, beachfront access and fireside terraces.
In the Cabanas, guests choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as a private cabana.
Booking a massage, facial or body treatment includes access to the spa's relaxation lounges, spa terrace and ocean-view spa pool.
Experiences range from private beach bonfires with s'mores to pool cabanas and surf lessons.

considerations.text: Spa services are open only to guests 14 and older.
WhataHotel notes that rooms in the historic original building may be smaller.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
